SELECT
    l_orderkey,
    l_linenumber,
    l_extendedprice,
    order_avg_extendedprice
FROM (
    SELECT
        l_orderkey,
        l_linenumber,
        l_extendedprice,
        AVG(l_extendedprice) OVER (PARTITION BY l_orderkey) AS order_avg_extendedprice
    FROM lineitem
)
WHERE
    l_shipmode = 'AIR'
    AND l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
    AND l_extendedprice > order_avg_extendedprice
ORDER BY
    l_orderkey ASC,
    l_linenumber ASC

WITH mozambique_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    o.o_orderpriority,
    l.l_extendedprice
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
  JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
  WHERE n.n_name = 'MOZAMBIQUE'
    AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F'
    AND o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate <= '1995-12-31'
    AND l.l_linestatus = 'F'
),
priority_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    o_orderpriority,
    SUM(l_extendedprice) AS priority_revenue
  FROM mozambique_orders
  GROUP BY o_orderpriority
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice) AS total_sum
  FROM mozambique_orders
)
SELECT 
  pt.o_orderpriority AS order_priority,
  pt.priority_revenue,
  ROUND((pt.priority_revenue / ts.total_sum) * 100, 2) AS revenue_percentage
FROM priority_totals pt
CROSS JOIN total_sum ts
ORDER BY revenue_percentage DESC, pt.o_orderpriority ASC

WITH daily_totals AS (
    SELECT
        l_shipdate AS ship_date,
        SUM(l_extendedprice) AS daily_total
    FROM lineitem
    WHERE l_shipmode = 'MAIL'
      AND l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01'
      AND l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
    GROUP BY l_shipdate
)
SELECT
    ship_date,
    daily_total,
    LAG(daily_total) OVER (ORDER BY ship_date) AS previous_total,
    daily_total - LAG(daily_total) OVER (ORDER BY ship_date) AS daily_change
FROM daily_totals
ORDER BY ship_date ASC
